soilLab.title: Viking's Soil Lab
soilLab.intro: Viking had tiny labs inside. Run all 3 experiments on the Mars soil, then decide what they prove.

experiments.label: Feed it nutrients
experiments.action: Adding a nutrient "soup" to the soil…
experiments.result: Gas bubbled out! Living things could do that… but so could special chemicals.

experiments.label: Heat it up
experiments.action: Baking the soil in a tiny oven…
experiments.result: When the soil was heated first, the reaction mostly stopped. Confusing!

experiments.label: Search for carbon molecules
experiments.action: Sniffing the soil with a super-nose instrument…
experiments.result: No organic molecules found. Living things are made of them, so this is a big clue.

soilLab.question: So… did Viking prove there is life on Mars?

options.text: Yes! The gas bubbles mean aliens!
options.feedback: Not so fast, detective! Chemicals can make bubbles too.

options.text: No. The soil reacted, but it might just be chemistry.
options.feedback: Exactly! Something happened, but there was no proof of life.
Hmm, something DID happen. Look at the results again.

rockScanner.title: Opportunity's Rock Scanner
rockScanner.intro: Scan each rock. Find the 2 rocks that hold clues about ancient water.

rocks.name: Blueberry Rock
rocks.look: Covered in tiny round grey balls
rocks.scan: Hematite spheres! These "blueberries" usually grow inside wet rock.

rocks.name: Layered Rock
rocks.scan: Fine layers laid down by gently moving water long ago.

rocks.name: Dark Rock
rocks.scan: Volcanic basalt. Cooled from lava, not formed by water.

rocks.name: Dusty Rock
rocks.scan: Just a normal rock wearing a coat of Mars dust. No water clue.

rockScanner.wrongHint: Ziggy: Hmm, that rock formed without water. Try another one!
rockScanner.success: Two water clues found! Mars was once wet.

digSite.title: Phoenix's Dig Site
digSite.intro: Use the robotic arm: click the soil squares to dig a trench. Find the hidden white patches.
digSite.foundText: White patches! Is it salt? Is it ice?
digSite.waitAction: Phoenix waits and takes a picture every day…
digSite.revealText: The white chunks VANISHED! Salt would stay. Ice turns straight into vapor in thin Mars air. It was WATER ICE!
